question_text: A 12-year-old boy is referred to a pediatric neurologist because of repetitive motions such as blinking or tilting his head. He is brought in by his mother who says that he also clears his throat and hums repeatedly. These actions have been happening for the past year and his mother is concerned. The boy was born at 39 weeks gestation via spontaneous vaginal delivery. He is up to date on all vaccinations and is meeting all developmental milestones. On physical exam, he shows no focal neurological deficits and is cognitively normal for his age. He occasionally sharply jerks his head to one side during the physical exam and utters obscene words. Which of the following is most associated with this condition?
